name: Special Heat Exchanger for Waste Heat Recovery
full_description: The official page lists THT welded plate heat exchangers for heat exchangers, air coolers, air preheaters, compressor interstage coolers, ammonia coolers, crude oil and residual-oil exchangers, power-plant air cooling, plate evaporative air cooling, MDEA solution heat exchange, and plate economizers. It says the waste-heat recovery welded plate heat exchanger is mainly used for industrial wastewater and exhaust gas, multi-effect evaporation tail gas in corn deep-processing, urban raw sewage, and heat recovery from flue gas generated by various fuels. The page emphasizes reliable sealing, long-cycle operation, low leakage and clogging risk, convenient maintenance and cleaning, and low maintenance cost.
advantage: Targets industrial wastewater, exhaust gas, flue gas, sewage, and evaporative tail-gas heat recovery.
Reliable welded sealing for long-cycle operation.
Designed to reduce leakage and clogging risk.
Convenient maintenance and cleaning with low maintenance cost.
